observations: Two photos show identical three-wheeled children's electric ride-on bikes, one red and white, one blue and white.
Both have a sporty motorcycle design with a front fairing, handlebars, a seat, and a rear wheel on each side.
The number '37' is visible on the front fairing and side panels of both bikes.
The text 'F3 RC' is visible on the side panel of both bikes, near the front wheel.

No power source, battery, or control panel is visible in either photo.
